selected.name: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
selected.why: Peru's national dish - a Chinese-Peruvian beef stir-fry served OVER french fries and rice. Both fries and Aji Amarillo Paste are board-tracked, and no lomo saltado exists in the catalog. Source publishes 565 cal/48.5g protein as served - clears the dinner gate outright. Batch skillet. HIGH confidence.

ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds flank steak sliced into 3-inch long thin strips against the grain
1 medium red onion chopped into large wedge pieces
French fries and rice for serving

selected.name: Filipino Beef Mechado
selected.why: Filipino tomato-soy beef braise - distinct from the catalog Filipino Beef Caldereta (no liver spread; brighter tomato-citrus). Beef chuck, tomato sauce, soy, potato all board-tracked; carrots/bell pepper are common tracked additions. Source 361 cal/31g is meat+potato+sauce; over rice ~560. HIGH confidence on protein, MED on gate.

cut.reason: Catalog dupe of live 'Mississippi Pot Roast Bowls' (slug mississippi-pot-roast-bowls). Identical dish: beef chuck roast + ranch seasoning + gravy mix + pepperoncini + butter, slow-cooker, shredded over starch. Same protein/sauce/starch/method - dead duplicate.

Catalog dupe of live 'Ropa Vieja Rice Bowls' (slug ropa-vieja-rice-bowls, cuisine Cuban). Same dish: flank/sirloin shredded beef in tomato-pepper-olive braise served over rice. Protein/sauce/starch/method all match.

Catalog dupe of live 'Slow Cooker Chile Colorado Bowls' (slug chile-colorado-bowls, cuisine Mexican). Same dish: beef chuck braised in a pure guajillo/ancho/arbol dried-chile puree, no beans, over rice. Candidate's 'why' defended against the wrong catalog entry (Beef Chili Rice Bowls) and missed the existing Chile Colorado. Protein/sauce/starch/method all match.

borderline.reason: Protein-twin of live 'Peruvian Pollo Saltado' (chicken). Same saltado stir-fry template: aji amarillo + soy + red wine vinegar, onion/tomato, served over fries + rice, skillet method; differs only in protein (beef vs chicken). Kept because Lomo Saltado is the canonical namesake beef dish and adds a beef entry to the Peruvian slice, but flagged for audit as a same-template, different-protein near-twin already in the catalog.

Shares beef chuck + tomato braise + potato/bell-pepper profile with live 'Filipino Beef Caldereta.' Distinguished by a soy-sauce + lemon-citrus, no-liver-spread/no-cheese sauce character (Caldereta here is the loaded liver/cheese/olive version), and they are canonically separate named Filipino dishes. Kept as a distinct regional take but flagged for audit.

shortfall.beef: Proof run, target up to 5 distinct. 2 selected of 5 candidates; 3 killed as hard catalog duplicates. No padding - genuine distinct beef dishes were only 2 (both borderline). More sourcing needed if a full 5-beef batch is required.
